about_the_game:
An Ordinary Top-Down Shooter is an ordinary top-down shooter game.

Trust me
This ordinary top-down shooter game, while ordinary, is fun
Just like ordinary you and ordinary me
Compared to geniuses, we're all ordinary
But if we put our heart into it
we are all interesting

Maybe I can't convince you this game is fun
But you came to Steam
aren't you looking for a fun game?
Why not download the free Demo and give it a try?

Core Features:

  • One-Shot Kill Hardcore Combat: Whether it's you or most enemies, everyone is extremely fragile. Every firefight is full of tension; precise shooting, quick reflexes, and using the environment are key to survival.

  • No Traditional Upgrades: I don't like upgrade systems because they make it hard for me to know if it's a skill issue or if I just didn't grind enough levels.

  • A Story About Ordinary People: It explores the story of an ordinary person struggling within their dreams.

An Ordinary Top-Down Shooter Game is dedicated to all the ordinary people who strive and persist.
